name: Loi du 11 mars 2018 relative aux établissements de paiement (PSD2)
description: Belgian transposition of PSD2. Supervised by NBB and FSMA.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Justel / eJustice (Belgium) (ejustice.just.fgov.be) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Justel / eJustice (Belgium) (ejustice.just.fgov.be).
